$comment: Scorecard standards (backlog scorecards-standards). The portal never invents a rule: every rule here is evaluated server-side by the cluster-api from the LIVE object, and the levels are attained bottom-up (gold requires every silver and bronze rule too). `check` is a fixed vocabulary the server implements; an unknown check makes the whole file invalid and scorecards come back as a named error, never as a pass. JSON rather than YAML because the Lambda ships no YAML parser and the other Git-owned inputs it reads (tool_catalog.json, registry.json) are JSON. Edit via MR: validate-platform.py lints this file.

rules.title: Resource is Ready
rules.description: The declared readiness condition is True. A resource that never converged is not usable by anyone.
rules.descriptionPt: A condição de prontidão declarada está True. Recurso que nunca convergiu não serve a ninguém.

rules.title: Owner declared
rules.description: Label platform.appmod/owner or spec.owner names a team or alias. Without it nobody is paged and nobody can approve a change.
rules.descriptionPt: Label platform.appmod/owner ou spec.owner nomeia um time ou alias. Sem isso ninguém é acionado e ninguém aprova mudança.

rules.title: Managed by GitOps
rules.description: Argo CD tracks the object (tracking annotation, instance label or the Application resource list). An object created by hand drifts from Git.
rules.descriptionPt: O Argo CD rastreia o objeto (annotation de tracking, label de instância ou a lista de recursos da Application). Objeto criado à mão deriva do Git.

rules.title: Status reflects the spec
rules.description: status.observedGeneration equals metadata.generation. A lagging status means the last change was not reconciled yet or the controller is stuck.
rules.descriptionPt: status.observedGeneration é igual a metadata.generation. Status atrasado significa que a última mudança ainda não foi reconciliada ou o controller travou.

rules.title: Environment declared
rules.description: spec.environment is set (lab, dev, prod). The compositions use it for naming and tagging the AWS resources they create.
rules.descriptionPt: spec.environment está preenchido (lab, dev, prod). As compositions usam o valor para nomear e etiquetar os recursos AWS que criam.

rules.title: Request provenance recorded
rules.description: The object carries who asked for it and through which path: platform.appmod/request-id or platform.appmod/mr-url annotation, or platform.appmod/plan-id or platform.appmod/requester label. Hand-written manifests have none.
rules.descriptionPt: O objeto carrega quem pediu e por qual caminho: annotation platform.appmod/request-id ou platform.appmod/mr-url, ou label platform.appmod/plan-id ou platform.appmod/requester. Manifest escrito à mão não tem nenhum.

rules.title: Project label for cost allocation
rules.titlePt: Label de projeto para alocação de custo
rules.description: Label platform.appmod/project names the owning project, so cost and inventory can be grouped without relying on the namespace alone.
rules.descriptionPt: Label platform.appmod/project nomeia o projeto dono, para custo e inventário agruparem sem depender só do namespace.
